name: @jdf/demo-edit-in-place
description: Demo video of JDF Reader's edit-in-place flow (Remotion) + a Playwright check that the real app behaves the same way.

scripts.render:gif: remotion render src/index.ts EditInPlace out/edit-in-place.gif --codec gif --every-nth-frame 2
scripts.stills: for f in 120 210 360 500 760 900; do remotion still src/index.ts EditInPlace out/still-$f.png --frame=$f; done
